column1: # clues.tsv for ft_strlcpy — hints only, never answers.
# The contract is the manual page: man 3bsd strlcpy, one page for strlcpy and
# strlcat. glibc 2.35 has neither function, so the page ships only in libbsd-dev
# (the dev container carries it; docs/environment.md, what you run by hand). With

What does strlcpy return -- and does that value depend on size at all? man 3bsd strlcpy says (no page installed? man.openbsd.org/strlcpy.3). Then the copy: the buffer holds size bytes and must end with a terminator inside it. How many characters can you actually copy before the terminator must go down?
What happens when size is 0? There is no room even for a terminator, so you must write nothing at all -- yet what should you still return?
